:= by
  intros
  have hX_bound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X ω| ≤ b - a :=
    by rw [Set.Icc.def]; exact hb.imp (fun ω => abs_le.2 (Icc.mem_iff.1 hb ω)).mpr (by simp)
  have hX_integrable : MeasureTheory.Integrable X μ :=
    by apply MeasureTheory.integral_norm_le; exact (MeasureTheory.integral_abs_le _ _ hX_bound).mp (by simp)
  have h_exp_strongly_measurable : MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) :=
    by apply MeasureTheory.exp_strongly_measurable; exact hm.ae_strongly_measurable
  apply MeasureTheory.condExp_stronglyMeasurable_mul_of_bound
    with (f := fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) (g := fun ω => 1) (c := 1)
    (hf_bound := hX_bound) (hg := hX_integrable)
    (hm := MeasurableSpace.subspace (by infer_instance))
    (hf := h_exp_strongly_measurable)
    (hg := by infer_instance)
